lens: Simulated Lucas Pope lens: legible rules, honest accounting, menu simplicity. This is an analytical lens, not his opinion. Fresh blind review of Kubono alpha.200.

strengths.finding: Progression and spending have distinct jobs: completing the preceding place opens the next; stars do not need to be spent. The objective exposes places completed and stars separately.
The menu has a clear primary layer and folds secondary systems into Más. Favorite editing and sharing are also folded beneath the return action.
Round rewards and spark purchases protect accounting on failed persistence through rollback; the ledger exposes earned and spent totals.

issues.finding: The round card can display 75 % a tiempo while denying the rhythm star: 74.6% rounds to 75 in the card, but the threshold uses the unrounded share. The card also omits the 75% requirement, so this boundary reads as inconsistent accounting.
issues.verification: Direct import: onTime=.746 gives displayPercent=75 and stars=[true,false,false].
issues.remedy: Show the required threshold beside the measured value and use a display precision or floor rule that never implies an unmet threshold has been reached.

issues.finding: The result timer wraps seconds before carrying into minutes. At 59,999 ms it displays 0:00; the same mismatch recurs just before subsequent minute boundaries.
issues.verification: Evaluating the exact formatting expression at 59999 returns 0:00.
issues.remedy: Compute one rounded or floored totalSeconds value, then derive both minutes and seconds from that value.

evidence: Read AGENTS.md and the six requested code/menu areas. No README, HANDOFF, PANEL, historical reviews, or prior scores read.

Viewed /tmp/panel9/capturas/00-inicio.png and /tmp/panel9/capturas/10-lugar-jardin.png: restrained monochrome scenes, tiny central cube, sparse pulse notation. Visual score is scoped to these static phone captures.
Ran one read-only Node expression importing roundStars and evaluating the exact timer expression. No repository edits or full suites.
limits: No interactive play, listening, or audio render inspected; audio and felt sensation remain null. Creativity/cohesion/polish scores are provisional static/source judgments on a 10-point scale.
No direct menu capture or novice observation. Folding reduces visible controls in source, but discoverability and comprehension are unmeasured.
